# consumermesh.com

> Consumer Mesh transforms Figma designs into production-ready, enterprise-grade websites and portals — no developers required. Built on headless Drupal and Next.js, it enables multi-brand organizations to launch faster, scale efficiently, and eliminate developer bottlenecks.

## Core Offerings
- [Home](https://www.consumermesh.com/) - Consumer Mesh automates website and portal creation directly from your Figma design. Deliver pixel-perfect, compliant, and scalable digital experiences without handoffs or rework. From design to code to launch — all connected.
- [Websites](https://www.consumermesh.com/websites/) - From Figma to enterprise-ready websites. Generate structured Drupal content models and static Next.js sites automatically. Fully responsive, accessible, and SEO-optimized. Launch anywhere — on Consumer Mesh or your own infrastructure.
- [Pricing](https://www.consumermesh.com/pricing/) - Transparent, scalable pricing for teams of all sizes. Plans start with Launch ($99/mo) for single-brand sites, Grow ($399/mo) for expanding brands, and Scale ($799+/mo) for enterprises. Includes white-glove setup, CMS configuration, and hosting flexibility.
- [About Us](https://www.consumermesh.com/aboutus/) - Meet the founders and discover how Consumer Mesh was built to solve the gap between design and delivery. Learn how we transform approved Figma designs into reliable, secure, enterprise-ready websites that launch exactly as envisioned.
- [Blog](https://www.consumermesh.com/blog/) - Articles exploring the future of design-driven web development, no-code enterprise technology, and headless architecture.

## Blog Highlights
- [Hello World](https://www.consumermesh.com/blogpost/hello-world/) - A designers first-hand look at launching a blog using Consumer Mesh — from Figma to a live, no-code experience.
- [Goodbye Drupal 7, Hello Freedom](https://www.consumermesh.com/blogpost/goodbye-drupal-7-hello-freedom/) - Drupal 7s end-of-life opens the door to no-code modernization. Move beyond migrations with automated Figma-to-Drupal workflows.
- [How I Made My Website AI-Friendly in Under an Hour](https://www.consumermesh.com/blogpost/how-I-made-my-website-AI-friendly-in-under-an-hour/) - Tips for optimizing your design-generated website for AI readiness and structured data.

## Who We Serve
- Consumer Brands (CPG) - Launch new campaigns and landing pages on demand.
- Multi-Brand Organizations - Scale consistently across brands with governance and flexibility.
- Agencies - Deliver premium, fast sites without additional development overhead.
- Higher Education - Build compliant, multi-site ecosystems with centralized governance.
